findings.label: R5.3 contradicts the unchanged stats payload
findings.detail: R5.3 says a Friend cannot reconstruct dates beyond latestVisitedOn, but the unchanged friend stats foodActivity (counted as friend-facing by R5.1) carries personalRecords.mostAdventurousDay.date and dishMarathonRecord.date.
findings.action: Scope R5.2/R5.3 to the new routes' payloads (list, Highlights, batch) or add an exception for the stats personal-record dates.

findings.label: Withdrawn stubs longer than one sentence
findings.detail: Requirements 1, 2, 7, 8, 9, 10 have two or three sentences instead of one.
findings.action: Trim each stub to one sentence; numbering and references unaffected.

findings.label: Residual removed-concept mentions
findings.detail: design.md A6 and tasks.md 1.1 mention migration 0062; task 3.1 says 'no sharing field exists'.
findings.action: Drop those clauses; 'no migration' already covers it.

findings.label: Withdrawn sub-criteria may trip the spec validator
findings.detail: 13.2, 13.6, 13.7 and 17.5 are numbered '(Withdrawn: ...)' items without SHALL; Kiro format diagnostics were not run in this step.
findings.action: Run the spec diagnostics after the next edit; if they flag these, fold them into an unnumbered note and keep the other criteria numbers.

findings.label: Task 3.5 guard matches only the word 'note'
findings.detail: A future SELECT fil.* or SELECT * on food_item_logs in stats/repo.ts would leak the note yet pass the source-level test.
findings.action: Also forbid fil.* and SELECT * in statements referencing food_item_logs.

findings.label: No non-forbidden error state for Friend Food History
findings.detail: R17.2/R17.4 mention retry and an error state and R11.4 covers Highlights, but R12 and tasks 4.4/4.5 define only empty, no-match and forbidden states for the full list.
findings.action: Add a failed-load state with retry and a test, or narrow R17's wording.

findings.label: EARS phrasing nits
findings.detail: R3.5 ('THE very next read' as subject), R5.1 ('NO friend-facing payload ... SHALL') and R5.4 ('THERE SHALL be') are not standard THE <system> SHALL form. R8.6 and R2.5 no longer exist because R8 and R2 are withdrawn.
findings.action: Reword without changing meaning or numbering.
